beginning_message: Hi, thanks for calling Summit Air — this is Alex, your dispatch assistant. How can I help with your heating or cooling today?
general_prompt: See prompts/system_alex.md for the full Alex system prompt. Follow guardrails in prompts/guardrails.json. On gas/CO, run prompts/scripts/evacuate_gas.md before any booking questions.

barge_in.notes: Retell native endpointing / overlap detection — agent stops speaking when the caller interrupts (address correction, urgency, etc.).
